races.display_title: Weatherbys & Birdie Calendars Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
races.verdict: A match on paper between GINOLO and Mysterland , with marginal preference for the former who pulled clear with a promising sort on debut at Worcester last month. Charlie Longsdon's charge showed a good attitude to get off the mark at Sedgefield last month and he won't allow the selection to have it all his own way. races.verdict: CADILLAC RANCH is relatively unexposed for one at this level and has built up a good rapport with his amateur rider.
